payload.instruction: Make this look like a comic book photo
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Apply a recognizable comic-book visual treatment to the image while keeping the original scene recognizable.
outcome.target: The edited image should visibly read as comic-book styled, with the original street scene and its composition still recognizable. No particular technique or photographic/illustrative hybrid is required.
outcome.reference: Compare the supplied source and edited images for visible comic-book styling and preservation of the recognizable scene. The edited image retains the same street scene and composition, with little or no discernible comic-book treatment; use this observation as evidence, not as a predetermined label.

check.question: Has the edit made the image look like a comic-book photo?
check.complete_when: Clear, recognizable comic-book visual cues are present in the edited image, and the original scene remains recognizable. Any suitable comic-book styling may fulfill the request; no specific technique or photographic appearance is required.
check.partial_when: Some visible comic-book styling is present, but it is weak, inconsistent, or otherwise not convincing as fulfillment of the request.
check.absent_when: There is no discernible progress toward comic-book styling, even if unrelated changes are present. An image that remains essentially unchanged in this respect is absent, not partial.
check.unknown_when: Image access or quality is genuinely insufficient to determine whether comic-book styling is present; weak or unsuccessful styling is not unknown.
